description: This file contains test cases for session key utilities and classification functions, including classification, parsing, validation, and session type derivation related to session keys used in a messaging or agent-based system.

methods.name: classifySessionKeyShape
methods.description: Classifies the shape of a session key, used to distinguish between different key formats such as agent, malformed, legacy, or alias.

methods.name: getSubagentDepth
methods.description: Calculates the depth of subagents within a session key, indicating hierarchical subagent levels.

methods.name: isCronSessionKey
methods.description: Checks if a session key corresponds to a cron job session based on its pattern.

methods.name: deriveSessionChatType
methods.description: Derives the type of chat (direct, group, channel, unknown) from a session key.

methods.name: parseThreadSessionSuffix
methods.description: Parses a session key to extract thread-specific information, such as thread IDs, especially for embedded topics.

methods.name: resolveThreadParentSessionKey
methods.description: Resolves the parent session key from a threaded session key.

methods.name: parseAgentSessionKey
methods.description: Parses and canonicalizes an agent session key, ensuring consistent casing and format.

methods.name: toAgentStoreSessionKey
methods.description: Generates a standardized session key for agent storage, avoiding duplication of prefixes.

methods.name: isValidAgentId
methods.description: Validates whether a given agent ID conforms to expected naming rules.
